verdict: QA-env artifact: server sets impronta_guest with Secure on every response; over plain http the browser drops it (cookies empty, fresh guest id per request) so /c/<inquiryId> 404s. With the Secure attribute stripped in-flight (Playwright route, no DB/product change) the cookie sticks and Confirm lands on /c/<inquiryId>?instant_booked=1 showing the thread page (Conversación abierta).
chromium_flag_unsafely-treat-insecure-or: did NOT help: window.isSecureContext stayed false, cookie still dropped, still 404
